scope: Separate scalar reference routine; not used by ACS production extraction
finding: At exhaustion, the zero-based loop index is returned as the number of iterations for max_iter > 1, causing capped=False even though all allowed iterations ran. The batched solver initializes counts to max_iter and does not have this bookkeeping symptom.
why_tol_zero: The implemented stopping statistic adds positive machine epsilon, so it cannot meet zero tolerance; both iterations must execute. This isolates cap bookkeeping independently of ECG convergence.
relation_to_04124: Not the cause: failed ACS extraction called the GPU batched solver, and frozen CPU vmd_batch reproduced the 128000 cap.
remediation: Correct scalar iteration counting and add regression tests in a separately documented shared-code revision; do not invalidate active frozen manifests silently.
